description: Make an HTTP request to a URL and return {status, headers, body}. Use this to demonstrate a mock by hitting it after `serve_locally` (e.g. `http://localhost:PORT/openapi/pet/findByStatus`), to inspect the admin API (`/.services` returns the registered services, `/healthz` for liveness), or to verify a freshly-mocked endpoint works. Default scope is localhost only; pass `allow_remote: true` for arbitrary URLs (rare — the bridge isn't a general-purpose HTTP client).
name: call_endpoint
